New commit: 5d0ba7a535bcc3998023f249ee1300d73e01f6c2
Evidence: https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP/blob/5d0ba7a535bcc3998023f249ee1300d73e01f6c2/src/nexus_mcp/server.py
Only the selected documented operation is a target; no gate or sealed observations are provided.

newContracts.description:
Use to look up a specific function/class/symbol by name — preferred
over Grep since it returns the definition plus its call-graph
relationships in one call. Set exact=False for fuzzy substring matching
when unsure of the exact name.

exact.description: True for exact match, False for fuzzy substring

newContracts.name: find_symbol
